decisions.reason: After two years with no quantified results and a non-core service, the option has shown little evidence of value and ongoing costs justify abandonment.
Despite maritime relevance, two years without results or a dedicated page suggest value is unlikely and the option should be dropped.
The growing partner network to six institutions indicates early value and low abandonment probability, so keep the option open.
Successful transfer of all FuelEU monitoring plans before the deadline demonstrates realized value, making drop very unlikely.
As a low-cost software option integrated into PAL and part of the emissions suite, uncertainty remains but the option is cheap to keep.
Similar to the dashboard, the simulator has uncertain prospects but low keeping costs, so it is retained as an option.
